title: ProgramBench: Can Language Models Rebuild Programs from Scratch?
summary: ProgramBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate whether large language models can accurately rebuild programs from scratch, testing their code memorization, understanding, and reconstruction capabilities across various programming scenarios.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of standardized evaluation methods to assess how well LLMs can reproduce and rebuild existing code programs accurately.
why_valuable: Provides researchers and developers with a systematic way to measure LLM code reconstruction abilities, revealing limitations in current models and guiding improvements in AI-assisted software development.
